propositions: CLI core top-level execution must dispatch through a single validated registry route after pre-operation help boundary instead of parallel explicit intercept ladders and policy frozensets.

Selected lazy handler reference must be resolved and invoked through a closed typed adapter-kind set (dispatcher, argv, argv_tracker, argv_tracker_root) with original remainder argv preserved and parsed exactly once by the selected S2 factory.

Registry-derived mount eligibility, initialization policy (none/init_only/full), confirmation, global output extraction, legacy output passthrough, and exception contracts must match pre-cutover behavioral census.

Execution must preserve tokens after `--`, legacy JSON shapes for create/idea/transition/claim/reopen, bridge compatibility spellings, and hidden bridge-status via approved adapters while keeping purge-bridge unknown.
Rollback capability must be maintained through derived compatibility exports without changes to handler modules, generated help, or persisted data.
Dispatch router must not re-parse command or nested options after route selection, and unrelated handler or optional-capability modules must not be imported during unrelated command execution.
